source.name: Early Stage Diabetes Risk Prediction Dataset

duplicate_analysis.rationale: The official UCI file itself contains 269 exact repeats (251 distinct rows), no identical feature vector has conflicting labels, and repeats are scattered rather than adjacent, so they cannot be proven accidental or genuine. Exact copies would otherwise fall on both sides of a train/test split and inflate hold-out metrics, so exact duplicates are removed before splitting. The raw file is kept unchanged.

cleaning_operations.detail: Missing targets are never imputed; rows are dropped before training.

missing_values_note: Remaining missing feature values are imputed inside the sklearn pipelines, fitted on training rows only.

verification.note: The duplicates are present in the official UCI file, not introduced locally.
